scientific_limitations: The upper bound requires an invertible affine Cartesian-product decomposition into at least two positive-dimensional convex factors.
The proof invokes the existing general Godbersen theorem and the existing type-B Narayana Hankel-total positivity theorem.
No quantitative statement is claimed for approximately decomposable convex bodies or for indexwise equality rigidity.
title: A sharp Godbersen gap for every affine Cartesian-product body
